description: The cases an employer filed on one day, each with its number, status and job title, and that day's totals: for someone who knows who filed and when, and never saw the number. PERM by default. The program may be pwd (prevailing wage), lca (H-1B) or seasonal (H-2A, H-2B, CW-1). With no match it returns the employers that filed that day under a close spelling. Example: {"employer": "Acme Robotics", "filed": "2026-01-30"}.

employer.description: The employer's name or its start.

job.description: Words of the job title, to narrow a long answer.

program.description: perm (the default), pwd, lca or seasonal.

name: find_case
title: Find a case without its number
